verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, a first-party toolkit with a hosted MCP server, the CLI, and pre-built skills, installable as plugins into Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Cursor. It lets AI agents run multi-step financial workflows on a production account on the user's behalf, so natural-language operation comes through Airwallex's own connectors and skills. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (the language layer is an external agent client), independent or hands-on corroboration, and coverage of money-out actions, which are disabled by default.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Airwallex AgentOS is a toolkit for AI agents that need to act on your production Airwallex account — reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports, and running multi-step financial workflows on your behalf.
Airwallex AgentOS MCP lets agents read and write production Airwallex resources from non-terminal environments
Power AI coding agents — let agents that can run terminal commands (for example, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex) operate against your account.
